function Get-WikidataExternalUrls ($qids, $PropIds, [switch]$OutSparql) {
    $qids = $qids -replace '.*/' | % {"wd:$_"} | select -unique
    $blocksToUnion = $propIds | ? {$_ -like 'P*'} | % {
    $propid = $_
@"
{
    ?q wdt:$propid ?$propid`Id.
    wd:$propid wdt:P1630 ?$propid`Fmt.
    BIND(IRI(REPLACE(?$propid`Id, "(^.*)", ?$propid`Fmt)) AS ?web)
}
"@
}

$propIds | ? {$_ -like '*wiki*'} | % {
    #$lang = $_.substring(0,2)
    $blocksToUnion += @"
  {
    ?w schema:about ?q;
      schema:isPartOf <https://$_.org/>.
    BIND(?w AS ?web)
  }
"@
}

$sparql = @"
SELECT ?q ?web WHERE {
	VALUES ?q { $qids }
$($blocksToUnion -join ' UNION ')
}
"@

if ($OutSparql) {return $sparql}
else {return (Invoke-Sparql $sparql)}
}
$sparql = @'
SELECT ?q ?birthdate ?deathdate ?birthplace ?deathplace ?birthcoord ?deathcoord ?page ?wikipedia ?web ?links WHERE {
  VALUES ?descBy {wd:Q125935456 }
  ?q p:P1343 ?stmt .
  ?stmt ps:P1343 ?descBy . #/wdt:P361*
  OPTIONAL { ?stmt pq:P2699 ?web. }
  OPTIONAL { ?stmt pq:P304 ?page. }
  OPTIONAL { ?q wdt:P569 ?birthdate }
  OPTIONAL { ?q wdt:P570 ?deathdate. }
  
  OPTIONAL { ?q wdt:P19 ?birthplace .
           OPTIONAL {?birthplace wdt:P625 ?birthcoord.}
           }
  OPTIONAL { ?q wdt:P20 ?deathplace.
            OPTIONAL {?deathplace wdt:P625 ?deathcoord.}
           }
  OPTIONAL {
    ?wikipedia schema:about ?q .
    ?wikipedia schema:isPartOf <https://ru.wikipedia.org/>.
    #?wikipedia schema:name ?wikiTitle.
    #?wikipedia schema:title ?wikiTitle.
    #BIND(IRI($articleWs) AS ?web).
  }
  
  OPTIONAL { ?q wikibase:sitelinks ?links. }
}
'@
$resp = Invoke-Sparql $sparql
$ppl = Merge-ObjectArrays $resp q -SingleValueProperties birthplace,deathplace,birthcoord,deathcoord

$ppl | ? birthdate | % {
$_.birthdate = $_.birthdate | ? {$_ -match '^\d'} | select -f 1

if ($_.birthdate) {
 $_.birthdate = $_.birthdate.Substring(0,10)
}

$p = $_
$_.psobject.properties | ? {!$_.value} | % {$p.psobject.properties.remove($_.name)}
}
$ppl | ? deathdate | % {
$_.deathdate = $_.deathdate | ? {$_ -match '^\d'} | select -f 1

if ($_.deathdate) {
 $_.deathdate = $_.deathdate.Substring(0,10)
}

$p = $_
$_.psobject.properties | ? {!$_.value} | % {$p.psobject.properties.remove($_.name)}
}

$pointToCountry = $ppl.birthcoord + $ppl.deathcoord | select -unique | python.exe reverseGeocode.py | ? {$_} | fromJson

$codes = $pointToCountry.country_code | select -Unique | Join-String -sep '" "'
$resp = Invoke-Sparql @"
SELECT ?country ?countryCode ?countryLabel WHERE {
  VALUES ?countryCode { "$codes" }
  ?country wdt:P297 ?countryCode.
  SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "ru,en". }
}
"@

$pointToCountry | % {
$obj = $_
$tmp = $resp | ? countryCode -eq $obj.country_code
Add-Member -inp $obj -NotePropertyName label -NotePropertyValue $tmp.countryLabel
}

$pointToCountryMap = $pointToCountry | group input -AsHashTable

foreach ($pPropName in @('birth','death')) {
  $ppl | ? "$pPropName`coord" | % {
    $p = $_
    if ($inf = $pointToCountryMap[$p."$pPropName`coord"] | select -f 1) {
    $label = $inf.label ?? $inf.country  | select -f 1
    Add-Member -inp $p -NotePropertyName "$pPropName`country" -NotePropertyValue $label -Force
    }
  }
}

Add-WikidataLabels $ppl
$ppl | % {$_.links = [int]$_.links}

$propIds = 'P6385,P11514,P2924,P1953,P1553,ru.wikipedia,commons.wikimedia' -split ','
$resp = Get-WikidataExternalUrls $ppl.q $propIds
$qToUrlsMap = $resp | group q -AsHashTable

$ppl | % {
$urls = @()
if ($tmp = $qToUrlsMap[$_.q]) {
$urls = $tmp.web
}
$urlsHref = $_.q,$_.web+$urls | % { $short = $_ -replace '^.*?https?://(www.)?(..).*','$2'; "<a href=$_ target='_blank'>$short</a>" } | Join-String -sep ' '
Add-Member -inp $_ -NotePropertyName urlsHref -NotePropertyValue $urlsHref -Force
}

$ppl | select qLabel,birthdate,@{n='birth';e={$year = $_.birthdate.substring(0,4); [int][math]::Floor($year / 50) * 50}},birthplaceLabel,birthcountry,deathdate,deathplaceLabel,deathcountry,links,urlsHref | sort {[int]$_.links} -desc | Format-HtmlTable -Description (gcb -Raw) -OutVariable html | Invoke-Item
